paper.title: SATE: Transferable Spin-Adapted Neural Wavefunctions
paper.authors: Timothy Sereda, Pallas Chou, Morris Hsieh, Emerson Hsieh

results.system_description: O2 triplet, isolated 3D continuum system in free space; 16 explicit electrons, Nup=9, Ndown=7, prescribed S=Ms=2/2. Fixed point nuclei: O Z=8, effective charge=8, at (0,0,0); O Z=8, effective charge=8, at (0,0,1.2) angstrom. Born-Oppenheimer Hamiltonian in atomic units: -1/2 sum Laplacians + sum_i<j 1/r_ij + electron-ion potentials + nuclear repulsion using effective charges; all-electron Coulomb electron-nucleus attraction. No spin-orbit coupling, no periodic images or applied field. Total energy in Hartree.
results.variant: 100k multi-system pretrained; 20k accepted adaptation updates; seed 42; prescribed spin S=2/2
results.source_location: Table 4, O2 triplet, pretrained seed 42; Methods: Independent energy evaluation; Appendix 5/Table 6
results.eligibility_evidence: Original spin-adapted neural determinant sum with Orbformer-derived spatial network and symmetric Jastrow; all learned parameters frozen after adaptation. Separate Metropolis evaluation retains every sampled local energy; clipping is only for optimization. Energy includes paired FP64 correction to FP32 evaluation.
results.notes: Printed pair: -150.301408 \pm 0.004057. Error is the conservative combination described in Methods: largest time-blocking/between-chain estimate, plus FP64-FP32 correction uncertainty; recorded as unspecified rather than assuming a pure standard error. Two separately seeded chains, each 256 walkers, 1200 burn-in sweeps and 512 records 60 sweeps apart. Four layers x width 256, 16 spatial components. HF basis sets are initialization only, not a basis-set Hamiltonian. Spin populations follow Methods Ms=S and charge/core counts. Cold-start two-seed averages, spin-excited terms and derived gaps/reaction energies are not transcribed. The energy is not a training-trace average.
